## This repository is a read-only release mirror

`novaos-agent-sdk-public` is a CI-produced release artifact: every commit on
`main` is a squashed export pushed automatically from the private source
repository when a release is tagged. It never receives a human commit, and
pull requests against it cannot be merged.

If you found a bug or have a feature request, please open an
[issue](../../issues) instead — do not open a pull request. Issues are
welcome and read by maintainers; PRs opened here will be closed
automatically.
